about: Synthetic demo project (fictional habit tracker, six weeks of chat). No real data. Each chat line: [day, user message, assistant report or empty]. Area terms are woven into the messages so the topics cluster; names are invented.
chat: We're keeping habit data in SQLite on the device: offline-first, the SyncEngine module just writes to the device cache, no sync server for now.
Done: SQLite schema for habits and check-ins, migrations in db/schema.sql. Commit 3f2a9c1, tests green.
Sign-up via magic link, no passwords: the Welcome screen asks for an email and the LinkSender service mails the sign-in email.
Done: magic-link sign-up, onboarding screens 1-3. Commit 8b41d07.
How should a streak handle a missed day on the StreakChart component?
Let's go with: a streak survives one missed day per week, and StreakChart shows that grace day as a gray dot.
Done: streak rule in streaks.py with one grace day per week, gray dots on the chart. Commit 51c0e8a.
StreakChart needs a chart legend that explains the grace day.
Done: grace-day legend under the streak chart. Commit 1e5f0d3.
No Firebase for sync. The SQLite file stays in the device cache and SyncEngine stays local.
Got it. Removed the Firebase sync stub; sync stays local in SQLite. Commit 2d7b3e4.
Reminders: one push per habit from the nudge-worker over the APNs channel, quiet hours 10 pm to 8 am.
Done: per-habit push reminders with quiet hours in reminders.py. Commit 0c9f6aa.
A home-screen widget with today's habits is a nice idea for the release plan, but parking it for later.
Paywall after the third habit: PaywallView offers the Plus plan with a 7-day trial week through StoreKit.
Done: paywall after the third habit, 7-day trial. Commit e47d2b9.
Add a HeatGrid of check-ins for the last 12 weeks on the stats screen.
Done: 12-week check-in heatmap in charts/heatmap.py. Commit 9a1c3f0.
Onboarding: drop the email step from the Welcome screen; LinkSender sends the magic link after the first habit.
Done: onboarding without the email step; the magic link goes out after the first habit. Commit 4be8d12.
Sync conflicts: last check-in wins, no merge dialog. SyncEngine just records the loser in the conflict log.
Done: last-write-wins for check-in conflicts in sync.py. Commit 77e0b5c.
HeatGrid weeks should start on Monday on the stats screen.
Done: heatmap weeks start on Monday. Commit 3a7e9b0.
Reminders: kill the evening digest push from the push schedule; nudge-worker keeps only the per-habit reminder.
Done: evening digest removed; per-habit reminders unchanged. Commit c3a84f1.
CSV export of habit data goes on the release plan as later.
Decided to move off on-device SQLite to a small sync server, hb-sync on Postgres: people want their streaks on two phones. The device cache stays as a local copy.
Done: hb-sync server on Postgres, habit data over HTTPS; SQLite is now only the device cache. Commit 6f12d9e.
Pricing for the Plus plan: $3 a month, $24 a year in PaywallView.
Done: prices in the paywall, $3 monthly and $24 yearly. Commit a90b7c2.
Rate-limit hb-sync to 60 requests a minute per device.
Done: 60 req/min per device on the sync server. Commit d48f1a3.
What happens to check-ins made offline while hb-sync is down?
Offline check-ins go into the check-in queue and SyncEngine replays them to hb-sync on reconnect.
Done: offline check-in queue, replayed on reconnect in sync.py. Commit 5d3c2a7.
Onboarding copy: shorter, three screens max after the Welcome screen.
Done: onboarding cut to three screens. Commit b2e9f41.
Importing steps from Apple Health as a first habit: later, after the release plan.
Paywall: instead of after the third habit, PaywallView shows up at the end of the first trial week.
Done: paywall moved to the end of the first trial week. Commit 0f7a6c8.
Push reminders: add a 'snooze for 1 hour' action on the notification screen.
Done: 1-hour snooze as a notification action in reminders.py. Commit 8c1d5e2.
HeatGrid colors from the brand palette, and the chart legend to match.
Done: heatmap uses the brand palette. Commit 2c8f6a1.
The widget isn't going into 1.0: it stays off the release plan for now.
No lifetime plan next to the Plus plan.
Noted: no lifetime plan in the paywall. Commit 72b0c9e.
SyncEngine crashes on reconnect when the check-in queue is empty, please fix.
Fixed: an empty offline queue no longer crashes sync on reconnect; test added. Commit 1b7e4d9.
Streaks: instead of one grace day a week, give two grace days a month, and update the chart legend.
Done: two grace days per month in streaks.py and the chart legend. Commit e1d6a07.
Let people change quiet hours on the notification screen.
Done: quiet-hours setting for reminders. Commit 4c9b2f5.
Sign-in email: the app icon and a single line of text in the email template.
Done: magic-link email template with the icon. Commit 9e3f7d1.
Release checklist for 1.0 on the release branch: sync, paywall, reminders, charts.
Done: checklist in docs/release.md, all four areas green. Commit 6b2a0e4.
StreakChart: show the best streak ever on the stats screen.
Done: best streak on the streak chart. Commit 7d1e0c4.
Dark theme for the charts: later.

Done: yearly plan listed first. Commit 3e8b1f6.
SyncEngine: gzip the requests to hb-sync.
Done: gzip on sync requests. Commit 0a4d7c3.
Onboarding: returning users skip the Welcome screen through a deep link.
Done: returning users skip onboarding. Commit 6c2f9a8.
Reminders: make snooze 30 minutes instead of an hour on the notification screen.
